for trial in range(60):
    # small dense cases so random walks can cover everything
    while True:
        c = random_case(rng)
        if sum(len(t) for t in c["threads"]) <= 5:
            break
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/main.py"], input=json.dumps(c)+"\n",
                       text=True, capture_output=True, cwd="/app")
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
    got = {json.dumps({"reads": o["reads"], "memory": o["memory"]}, sort_keys=True)
           for o in json.loads(p.stdout)["outcomes"]}
    rand = random_terminal_outcomes(c, rng, 3000)
    randk = {json.dumps({"reads": [list(o) for o in obs], "memory": list(mem)}, sort_keys=True)
             for obs, mem in rand}
    missing = randk - got
    assert not missing, ("random found extra", c, missing)
    # for very small programs random walks should cover all
    if sum(len(t) for t in c["threads"]) <= 4 and randk != got:
        print("note: random walk did not cover all (case too big for 3000 walks?)")
        print(json.dumps(c)); print("uncovered:", got - randk); sys.exit(1)
    ok += 1
print("converge OK", ok)
